title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: enhanced IntelliFrame uses an AI data channel from intelligent cameras
summary: Hold: the privacy discussion says Microsoft has not stated where the AI metadata is processed, but its notice explicitly says processing occurs on the device. The roadmap facts, licensing, default state and documented recognition controls are supported; one rollout sentence also needs to preserve Microsoft's planned timing rather than promise a start date.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Pro Management Portal path to room face recognition is Rooms > Settings > Recognition > Configure with device settings > Face Recognition.
claims.quote: Select **Rooms**. Select **Settings** followed by the **Recognition** tab. Enable **Configure with device settings**. | Face Recognition | Off | Users with enrolled face profile are identified with their face when using this device.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RoomPeopleNameUserOverride On sets the meeting-policy option for video-based people recognition.
claims.quote: [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>] [-RoomPeopleNameUserOverride <String>] On: Policy value allows People recognition option on Microsoft Teams Rooms under call control bar.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends configuring recognition through device-level settings.
claims.quote: We recommend using device-level settings because meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Meeting-policy-based recognition configuration is an alternative that Microsoft says will be retired.
claims.quote: Recognition in Teams Rooms can be configured through either device-level settings or a Teams Meeting policy. We recommend using device-level settings because meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.claim: No admin UI for configuring the Teams AI enrolment policy is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AI policy EnrollFace enrollment admin UI Teams admin center. Opened voice-and-face-recognition and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; the enrolment page says the policy is accessible only through PowerShell. The documented admin UI manages profile data, not policy parameters.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled disables face enrolment in the Global Teams AI policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollVoice Enabled -EnrollFace Enabled; New-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity DisableEnrollment -EnrollVoice Disabled -EnrollFace Disabled

claims.claim: New-CsTeamsAIPolicy and Grant-CsTeamsAIPolicy can create and assign a custom enrolment policy to selected users.
claims.quote: New-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity DisableEnrollment -EnrollVoice Disabled -EnrollFace Disabled; Grant-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity DisableEnrollment -Identity testuser@test.onmicrosoft.com

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; controls[2].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No dedicated tenant-wide or per-room switch for the enhanced IntelliFrame AI data channel is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'enhanced IntelliFrame' 'AI data channel' settings disable metadata; Teams Rooms intelligent cameras AI data channel PowerShell enable disable recognition metadata processing. Opened Cloud IntelliFrame, people recognition, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; no dedicated switch.

claims.claim: Administrators can view end-user voice and face enrolment status in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can now use **Teams admin center** to view end-user **voice and face enrollment status** and manage enrolled data directly from the admin experience.

claims.claim: Administrators can delete end-user voice and face profiles in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can also **delete end-user voice and face profiles and enrollment data directly from the Teams admin center**.

claims.claim: The cited enrolment page does not give a navigation path for its Teams admin center profile-management experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AI policy EnrollFace enrollment admin UI Teams admin center. Read voice-and-face-recognition in full, including Manage enrollment data in Teams admin center; it describes viewing and deleting profiles but gives no navigation path for that experience.

claims.claim: Enrolment policy controls profile creation separately from whether a Teams Room uses profiles for recognition.
claims.quote: To provide granular controls for Enterprise administrators, there's a separate configuration to allow Teams Rooms to utilize user voice and face profiles to identify who is in a meeting room.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the contents of the enhanced IntelliFrame AI metadata.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams enhanced IntelliFrame AI data channel metadata contents retention processing. Read MC1442614, Multi-Stream IntelliFrame and Cloud IntelliFrame; no enhanced-channel metadata schema or contents were specified. Search results discuss neighbouring features, not this channel.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said where the enhanced IntelliFrame AI metadata is processed.
claims.quote: By processing AI metadata directly on the device and sending it through a dedicated data channel rather than relying only on cloud processing
claims.fix: Replace the first Data exposure bullet with: 'The new data path is AI metadata sent from the camera through a dedicated data channel. MC1442614 says AI metadata is processed directly on the device and asks organisations to review the feature against their policies; the notice does not specify the metadata contents or its destination after transmission.' In Open questions, replace 'where is it processed' with 'what is its destination after transmission'. The current assertion also conflicts with the on-device processing already described in What's changing.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls; Open questions

Opened people recognition, voice-and-face-recognition, Multi-Stream IntelliFrame and Cloud IntelliFrame; their controls cover recognition and enrolment, not the enhanced channel.

claims.claim: The recognition documentation lists the room Face Recognition device setting as Off by default.
claims.quote: | Face Recognition | Off | Users with enrolled face profile are identified with their face when using this device. Others are distinguished as meeting participants. |

claims.claim: MC1442614 asks organisations to review the feature against their policies.
claims.quote: This feature uses on-device AI processing to improve meeting experiences. Metadata is transmitted through a dedicated data channel. Review based on your organization’s policies.
